Hikaru"Exactly!"
Kageaki"Hh...!?"
Hikaru"Humanity will perish... and the last one victorious shall earn the right to call themselves God!"
Hikaru"There is Hikaru's path of dominion."

Hikaru"Hm. Was something wrong? ...No, surely not."
Hikaru"Think logically. There is only one way to qualify as God! Fight all humanity and win!!"
Kageaki"————"
Hikaru"For that, first all humanity must be brought onto the battlefield. It was an unexpected blessing that Muramasa's song can transfer Hikaru's heart to other people."
Hikaru"Chase feeble people who run at the sight of a blade, and cut them from behind? Cowardly. Despicable. Make them fierce beasts who fight as they please; meet them as equals. Only then does victory have meaning."
Hikaru"After a fair contest, I shall stand at the summit. And once I attain godhood—Hikaru's purpose will be fulfilled also."
Kageaki"...Purpose?"
